hero_eyebrow: A note from Dr. Srikanth Kulkarni, the mentor.
case_study_body: Sunsuvin's founding engagement is with the Walmart Vriddhi Program. I have mentored Indian MSME and e-commerce entrepreneurs in building and scaling their businesses on digital marketplaces, particularly Flipkart. Through personalized 1:1 mentoring and group sessions which helped entrepreneurs identify business bottlenecks and develop practical solutions across product selection, listing optimization, pricing, keywords, product images, advertising, marketplace visibility, profitability, inventory, returns, logistics, brand approval and seller-support issues. My approach goes beyond solving immediate problems—I focus on teaching entrepreneurs how to understand marketplace dynamics, interpret business metrics and make better data-driven decisions independently. The mentoring helped bridge the gap between traditional business practices and digital commerce, enabling entrepreneurs to move from guesswork to structured decision-making and from simply listing products to strategically building sustainable online businesses.
